name: photos
title: Photo upload with R2 and a D1 feed
summary: Upload images (JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, or AVIF up to 10 MB) to R2 with a caption. Each upload stores one D1 row and appears in a newest-first feed served through a caching image route. Signed-out visitors see the feed and a sign-in link; uploads need an account.
